channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Iran hits Kurdish groups in Iraq as conflict widens
item.description: TEHERAN: Fresh blasts were reported in Iran’s capital on Thursday as Teheran said it had targeted Kurdish groups in Iraq and warned “separatist groups” against action in the widening war.

item.title: Alcaraz unbeaten run under threat from Sinner, Djokovic at Indian Wells
item.description: INDIAN WELLS: Former champion Carlos Alcaraz aims to extend his perfect start to 2026 at Indian Wells while Jannik Sinner returns to the California desert seeking to fill a gap in his resume with his first title of the year.

item.title: Yulia Putintseva sends Paula Badosa packing in first round at Indian Wells
item.description: INDIAN WELLS: Yulia Putintseva needed just 83 minutes on Wednesday to post a 6-4, 6-2 victory over 2021 champion Paula Badosa in the first round of the BNP Paribas Open at Indian Wells, Calif.

item.title: Power generator rental nears RM680mil amid data centre, telco expansion
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Demand for power generator rentals in Malaysia is expected to grow strongly in the coming years, driven by infrastructure development, telecommunications projects and rising investment in data centres.

item.title: Israel strikes Beirut, Lebanon state media says Hamas official killed
item.description: BEIRUT: Israel said it carried out strikes on Beirut targeting Iran-backed militant group Hizbollah on Thursday, while Lebanese state media reported an Israeli drone strike killed a Hamas official.

item.title: Hamilton reveals sequel in the works to blockbuster 'F1: The Movie'
item.description: MELBOURNE: Lewis Hamilton revealed Thursday he was working on a sequel to the blockbuster Brad Pitt film ‘F1: The Movie’, with a script being written.

item.title: Afghans rally against Pakistan and civilian casualties
item.description: GARDEZ: Decorating their soldiers with colourful garlands, hundreds of Afghans rallied in border provinces to decry Pakistan killing civilians and to show support for their troops battling at the frontier.

item.title: Gilgeous-Alexander rules over Knicks again in Thunder win
item.description: LOS ANGELES: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander sank a clutch three-pointer to secure a hard-fought 103-100 win for the Oklahoma City Thunder over the New York Knicks Wednesday.

item.title: Bank Negara keeps OPR at 2.75pct in second MPC meeting
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Bank Negara Malaysia has kept the overnight policy rate (OPR) unchanged at 2.75 per cent, maintaining the level set in July 2025.

item.title: Speedy Tigers hope to stick it to England in David-Goliath clash
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: National coach Sarjit Singh will need to weave his magic to inspire his players when they face world No. 4 England in the World Cup qualifier semi-finals in Ismailia, Egypt, on Friday.
